corrections.text: It is not impossible to fulfill the dream you desire without giving anything up.
corrections.reason: Separates the 3610–3612 wish-fulfillment statement from the following hope box.

corrections.text: You showed a light of hope to my despairing heart.
corrections.reason: Restores the wholly blank 3613–3615 hope box.

corrections.text: If you keep moping, I will not be able to go to the other side in peace...
corrections.reason: Restores Rikuto as the speaker who cannot depart in peace while Kyuuma keeps wavering.

corrections.text: And tell my wife and child to live well, too.
corrections.reason: Restores Rikuto’s final request, including the additive も (too), without adding unsupported tone.
